scoring.pass_rule: Award 2 points only when the required evidence exists and the verification method passes. Otherwise award 0. No partial credit in the canonical release score.
scoring.release_rule: A 100/100 release score is prohibited while any public-release gate in src/config/release.ts is BLOCKED.
scoring.evidence_rule: AI judgement, simulation or internal preference cannot substitute for evidence explicitly requiring a farmer, legal approval, rights/provenance, company fact, consent or independent domain review.
scoring.freshness_rule: Use the current repository HEAD and current evidence references. Do not persist a current total inside this contract because it would become stale.

criteria.title: Hero communicates the farmer/economic job in 5–10 seconds
criteria.evidence_required: Documented target-farmer message test showing correct open-recall understanding of farm relevance, economic decision job and next step, with material misclassifications below the canonical kill threshold.
criteria.verification: Review the approved WWW-000 result against Blueprint §17 counting/kill rules and confirm the public hero matches a surviving message.

criteria.title: Farmer problem is concrete before methodological depth
criteria.evidence_required: Homepage presents concrete farmer economic questions and fragmented-record problem before deep methodology, with no unsupported capability claim.
criteria.verification: Manual content-order review plus browser assertions on homepage problem/proof sections.

criteria.title: Current product vs company direction is unambiguous
criteria.evidence_required: Field Profitability is clearly marked as the first concrete product and in development; crop/horticulture/livestock are described only as master-brand direction unless separately proven shipped.
criteria.verification: Claim-hygiene review and browser regression checks on homepage/product/company scope language.

criteria.title: Farmer decision authority is explicit
criteria.evidence_required: Decision-support language consistently keeps the farmer as decision owner and avoids autonomous-prescription framing.
criteria.verification: Claim-hygiene scan plus browser/content assertions across homepage, product and trust routes.

criteria.title: Next action is clear and low friction
criteria.evidence_required: Primary CTA is understandable, pilot step is explained and first contact asks only minimum contact/context information.
criteria.verification: Browser CTA/form tests plus farmer comprehension evidence that the next step is understood.

criteria.title: Field Profitability status and scope are truthful
criteria.evidence_required: Public copy states In development — not yet available and exposes current documented inputs, outputs and exclusions without implying production availability.
criteria.verification: Browser assertions and claim-hygiene validation.

criteria.title: Economic metric definitions are canonical and confirmed
criteria.evidence_required: Operating profit and related public metrics use confirmed canonical definitions with provenance; no provisional definition can render publicly.
criteria.verification: Domain tests and Metric component release guard.

criteria.title: Illustrative economics are visibly hypothetical
criteria.evidence_required: Synthetic example is labelled Hypothetical / Not assessed, arithmetic is correct and statistical plausibility evidence is retained.
criteria.verification: Domain arithmetic tests, browser labels and evidence reference review.

criteria.title: Target-market economic example has human domain sign-off
criteria.evidence_required: A Market-A human domain/economic reviewer validates values, units, allocations and local terminology for the public example.
criteria.verification: Review recorded domain sign-off and confirm the rendered example matches the approved scenario.

criteria.title: Capability boundaries and exclusions remain inspectable
criteria.evidence_required: Whole-farm P&L, tax/financing, GIS, telemetry, ERP, optimisation, forecasting and other non-current capabilities are not implied as current Field Profitability functions.
criteria.verification: Claim-hygiene scan and browser assertions on product boundary content.

criteria.title: Evidence ladder semantics are consistent
criteria.evidence_required: Hypothetical → Modelled → Observed → Attributed → Verified is used consistently and no value is promoted to a higher state without evidence.
criteria.verification: Domain/evidence tests, claim-hygiene checks and content review.

criteria.title: Confidence semantics are distinct from evidence state
criteria.evidence_required: High / Medium / Low / Insufficient evidence are assessed confidence states and Not assessed remains a separate meta-state.
criteria.verification: Domain tests and rendered confidence-component review.

criteria.title: Plain-language evidence definitions are approved against the PROFIT VEV standard
criteria.evidence_required: Public definitions of evidence states and Verified Economic Value are explicitly approved and aligned with the current VEV methodology.
criteria.verification: Review the approved VEV/evidence-definition decision record and rendered copy.

criteria.title: Attribution and causality boundaries are explicit
criteria.evidence_required: The site distinguishes forecast, modelled benefit, observed outcome, attribution and Verified value, and exposes the verification chain where relevant.
criteria.verification: Browser/content assertions on evidence and methodology surfaces.

criteria.title: Unsupported superiority, profit and accuracy claims are absent
criteria.evidence_required: Production copy contains no unverified customer result, guaranteed profit uplift, unsupported accuracy, fabricated social proof or superiority claim.
criteria.verification: Claim-hygiene validator plus manual release claim audit.

criteria.title: Publishable privacy notice is approved
criteria.evidence_required: A jurisdiction-appropriate privacy notice is approved for publication and matches actual collection/processing behavior.
criteria.verification: Legal approval reference plus rendered privacy content review.

criteria.title: Farm-data terms are approved
criteria.evidence_required: Ownership/control, purpose, sharing, retention, deletion/export and end-of-pilot treatment are documented and approved.
criteria.verification: Legal/product approval reference plus rendered data-terms review.

criteria.title: Permission and purpose are visible in the product story
criteria.evidence_required: Public UX explains that farm records are used with permission and for a stated purpose without inventing stronger legal guarantees.
criteria.verification: Claim-hygiene review and browser assertions on trust/pilot content.

criteria.title: First contact minimizes farm-data collection
criteria.evidence_required: Pilot form contains only Name, Farm/company, Country, Email and Farm type; no farm economics or operational records are requested initially.
criteria.verification: Browser form-field count/content test.

criteria.title: Security/privacy wording matches implemented reality
criteria.evidence_required: No security, ownership, compliance or data-use claim exceeds approved policy and implemented system behavior.
criteria.verification: Final legal/engineering release claim audit.

criteria.title: Legal company identity is complete
criteria.evidence_required: Required legal company name, registration/business information, jurisdiction and publication details are factual and complete.
criteria.verification: Cross-check rendered company/footer details against authoritative company records.

criteria.title: Direct contact path is operational
criteria.evidence_required: Farmers, investors/partners and other enquiries have a confirmed reachable contact path.
criteria.verification: Send/receive smoke test and rendered contact-link review.

criteria.title: Team proof and consent are complete
criteria.evidence_required: Names, public role wording, relevant expertise, profile/photo use and consent are confirmed by each published team member.
criteria.verification: Review individual confirmations and rendered team records.

criteria.title: Team capabilities explain why the team fits the problem
criteria.evidence_required: Team presentation ties agriculture/farm operations, science/engineering/data and product/software/AI capabilities to concrete PROFIT responsibilities without generic CV filler.
criteria.verification: Content review against confirmed bios and company capability flow.

criteria.title: No fabricated customers, partners, testimonials or founder mythology
criteria.evidence_required: All company proof is factual; unknowns remain explicit; no placeholder is styled as real social proof.
criteria.verification: Claim-hygiene validator and manual release audit.

criteria.title: Production art direction is validated with target farmers
criteria.evidence_required: Farmer testing supports the production direction on comprehension and calibrated trust without recurring dashboard/accounting/GIS misclassification.
criteria.verification: Review WWW-001/WWW-002 farmer-test evidence against canonical AD criteria.

criteria.title: Documentary agriculture has verified rights and provenance
criteria.evidence_required: At least one approved real agricultural asset has recorded source, rights/provenance and appropriate context; no synthetic image is presented as documentary.
criteria.verification: Asset provenance record plus rendered-image inspection.

criteria.title: B2 visual grammar remains recognizable without generic SaaS cues
criteria.evidence_required: Production-unit context, economic typography, evidence/confidence and farmer-decision grammar remain coherent without generic green SaaS/dashboard/bento/AI decoration.
criteria.verification: Logo-off internal/target-user comparison and final design-system review.

criteria.title: Master-brand grammar transfers across production systems
criteria.evidence_required: The brand invariant works for field crops, horticulture/greenhouse and livestock without forcing per-hectare or field-geometry language onto non-crop domains.
criteria.verification: Cross-domain transfer review using canonical production-unit examples.

criteria.title: Every major visual choice has a communication purpose
criteria.evidence_required: Final visual audit finds no decorative complexity that weakens comprehension, trust, accessibility or performance.
criteria.verification: Blueprint §20 acceptance review and final design challenge pass.

criteria.title: Pilot response process is operationally defined
criteria.evidence_required: Named operational owner, response channel and realistic response process are confirmed.
criteria.verification: Operational runbook plus end-to-end inquiry smoke test.

criteria.title: Pilot form remains five-field and qualified
criteria.evidence_required: Form asks exactly the approved five contact/context fields and explains what happens next.
criteria.verification: Browser form tests.

criteria.title: Production form delivery is reliable and privacy-gated
criteria.evidence_required: Production endpoint validates server-side, delivers to the confirmed destination, fails safely and cannot be configured before required privacy/company/process gates are ready.
criteria.verification: Integration/smoke tests plus existing release-configuration guard.

criteria.title: Form states are accessible and resilient
criteria.evidence_required: Validation, error, retry and success states are keyboard/screen-reader usable and do not lose user input unnecessarily.
criteria.verification: Browser accessibility/form-flow tests plus manual keyboard/screen-reader smoke test.

criteria.title: Conversion copy is honest and non-coercive
criteria.evidence_required: CTA copy does not imply instant onboarding, product availability, artificial urgency or guaranteed outcome.
criteria.verification: Claim-hygiene and final content audit.

criteria.title: Automated WCAG A/AA checks pass on critical routes
criteria.evidence_required: Axe reports zero WCAG A/AA violations on critical routes at 390/768/1024/1440 in the exact release candidate.
criteria.verification: Site Verify Playwright/Axe job.

criteria.title: Keyboard, focus and screen-reader manual checks pass
criteria.evidence_required: Manual audit verifies logical keyboard order, visible focus, landmarks/headings, interactive names, disclosure/menu/form behavior and representative screen-reader sanity.
criteria.verification: Signed manual accessibility checklist tied to release SHA.

criteria.title: Zoom and reflow are usable
criteria.evidence_required: Content and core interactions remain usable at required zoom/reflow conditions without loss of information or two-dimensional scrolling where WCAG prohibits it.
criteria.verification: Manual zoom/reflow audit tied to release SHA.

criteria.title: Reduced-motion behavior is complete
criteria.evidence_required: Meaning does not depend on animation and motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
criteria.verification: Browser reduced-motion tests plus manual inspection of animated states.

criteria.title: Responsive layouts have no critical overflow or hierarchy failure
criteria.evidence_required: Critical routes pass 390/768/1024/1440 overflow/runtime tests and mobile keeps farmer value/proof/CTA hierarchy.
criteria.verification: Site Verify browser QA plus manual spot check on representative devices.

criteria.title: Static/minimal-JS architecture remains intact
criteria.evidence_required: Core presentation works as static semantic HTML/CSS with only justified client JavaScript and no unnecessary runtime/framework dependency.
criteria.verification: Build artifact/dependency review and no-JS sanity check.

criteria.title: Core Web Vitals meet quality targets
criteria.evidence_required: LCP ≤ 2.5 s, INP ≤ 200 ms and CLS ≤ 0.1 at p75 mobile/desktop when RUM exists; before sufficient RUM, production-equivalent lab evidence must show no material risk and the criterion remains provisional until RUM closes it.
criteria.verification: Production RUM report when statistically meaningful; production-equivalent lab audit during launch preparation.

criteria.title: Critical routes have no console, page or request failures
criteria.evidence_required: Critical route/browser matrix produces no console errors, page errors or failed critical requests.
criteria.verification: Site Verify runtime-failure collection.

criteria.title: Images and fonts follow performance policy
criteria.evidence_required: Responsive image formats/sizes, explicit dimensions, appropriate loading priority and minimal font payload/preload strategy are implemented for real production assets.
criteria.verification: Asset audit plus production network/waterfall inspection.

criteria.title: Exact release SHA passes the complete CI contract
criteria.evidence_required: Design check, claim hygiene, scorecard check, Astro/type checks, domain tests, production build, release negative build and browser/Axe QA all succeed on the exact release SHA.
criteria.verification: GitHub Actions checks for the release SHA.

criteria.title: All public-release gates are READY with evidence
criteria.evidence_required: Every gate in src/config/release.ts is READY and carries an auditable evidence reference.
criteria.verification: Release configuration check against referenced evidence.

criteria.title: Indexability cannot bypass release truth
criteria.evidence_required: SITE_INDEXABLE=true fails while any public gate is blocked and succeeds only after all gates are legitimately ready.
criteria.verification: CI release-gate negative/positive release-candidate tests.

criteria.title: Production SEO/URL infrastructure is correct
criteria.evidence_required: Canonical production origin, robots, sitemap, metadata and route status behavior are correct on the deployed release candidate.
criteria.verification: Production smoke test and crawl/metadata inspection.

criteria.title: Operational ownership and monitoring are defined
criteria.evidence_required: Named ownership exists for website availability, contact/pilot delivery, privacy requests and critical incident follow-up; monitoring appropriate to the static site/form path is active.
criteria.verification: Operational runbook plus notification/delivery smoke tests.

criteria.title: Documentation and implementation agree at release
criteria.evidence_required: Canonical docs, compact AI context, implementation status and release configuration describe the actual release; no known critical content gap is hidden.
criteria.verification: Docs Contract CI plus final evidence/challenge/execution audit.
